description:
A presentation helper, `MinimalIssue::state_symbol`, lives in the domain, and the output layer holds an identical twin.

## Background

`MinimalIssue::state_symbol` (`crates/jit/src/domain/types.rs:746`) has one production caller, `print_issue_show_human` (`main.rs:2088`), which renders `IssueShowResponse.dependencies: Vec<MinimalIssue>` (`output.rs:1866`). `DependencyTreeNode::state_symbol` (`output.rs:1607`) maps states to the same symbols. Presentation belongs to the output layer, and two copies of one mapping diverge.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `MinimalIssue::state_symbol` no longer exists.
- [hard] REQ-02: One output-layer function maps a lifecycle state to its symbol, and both issue-show dependency rendering and dependency-tree rendering call it.
- [hard] REQ-03: Human output for issue show and dependency trees is unchanged.
title: Render state symbols in the output layer
